fact: Sudan's Minister of Digital Transformation announced the 1,300 sq m state data centre in Khartoum State restored and operating after rehabilitation, equipped for cloud computing and hosting systems for public and private institutions and citizens.

Sudani's deputy director general says the company restored its core data centre, now fully operational and serving government bodies, private institutions and citizens; the article gives no date of restoration, so as_of is the article date.

Sudani's deputy director general says the company lost its Tier-4 data centre that hosted state government and institutions, along with other assets, in damage exceeding USD 70 million; no date of loss is given, so as_of is the article date.

Actum Sudan reports, citing the minister, that the state's 1,300 sq m Khartoum data centre was reactivated after rehabilitation, with cloud computing and data protection, to host government systems and serve public and private institutions and citizens.

SUNA, via Sudan Akhbar, reports the minister announcing the 1,300 sq m Khartoum State data centre restored and returned to service after rehabilitation, with cloud computing and data security, serving government and public and private institutions.

Sudatel's operator page presents the Sudatel Data Center (SDC) as operating and offering services to institutions in Sudan and to customers in north and east Africa, and calls it the largest data centre in Sudan; the page has no event date, so the 2024-01-01 published date is used.

Sudatel itself states, on its operator page and with no certification body named, that the Sudatel Data Center (SDC) is a Tier IV data centre with 99.995% availability; the page has no event date, so the 2024-01-01 published date is used.

Sudatel operates a data centre in Sudan that provides colocation services under a leasing contract to the Sudan Taxation Chamber for its main data centre, with Sudatel supplying operation, internet and monitoring at what the page calls 'Level 4 service'; the page gives no event date, so this is its published date.
